    res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':33,'col':52}])
    r=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    ys=[(i,j) for i in range(64) for j in range(64) if r[i][j]=='Y']
    def sruns(r,c):
        runs=[];start=None

    if res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done'):
        print('LEVEL DONE'); break
